This game needs WebGL (3D graphics). Please turn on hardware acceleration in your browser settings, or try Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
EPOCHSOFCONQUEST
Build. Advance. Conquer. From the Industrial Age to the Future.

Goal

Gather resources, grow your base, advance through 4 ages (Industrial → Modern → Digital → Future) and destroy every enemy. With the Wonder rule on, holding an Orbital Spire for 4 minutes also wins.

Economy

Engineers gather Food (berries, farms), Timber (trees), Metal (ore) and Energy (crystals). They carry it to a Command Center or Supply Depot. Build Housing Blocks for more population.

Mouse

Left-click / drag to select. Double-click selects all of a type. Right-click to move, gather, build, repair or attack. Wheel zooms, middle-drag pans, minimap jumps.

Keys

Command buttons use Q W E R T / A S D F G / Z X C V B. Arrows or screen edge scroll. Ctrl+1-9 makes groups. H = HQ, . = idle Engineer, , = idle army, Space = jump to selection, +/- = game speed, Esc = pause.
Free, runs in your browser, no downloads. Original game, art made in code.
